request.initial_prompt: Edmund. Persuade me to the murder of your lordship; But that I told him the revenging gods 'Gainst parricides did all their thunders bend; Spoke with how manifold and strong a bond The child was bound to the father; sir, in fine, Seeing how loathly opposite I stood To his unnatural purpose, in fell motion With his prepared sword, he charges home My unprovided body, latch'd mine arm; But when he saw my best alarum'd spirits, Bold in the quarrel's right, rous'd to th'encounter, Or whether gasted by the noise I made, Full suddenly he fled.

Edmund!
Persuade me to the murder of your lordship, but that I told him the
revenging gods, against parasites did all their thunders bend, spoke with
how manifold and strong a bond the child was bound to the father.
Sir, in fine, seeing how loathly opposite I stood to his unnatural
purpose, in fell motion with his prepared sword, he charges home my
unprovided body, latched mine arm.
But when he saw my best elarimed spirits, bold in the quarrels right,
roused to tea a chenk hunter, or weather gasted by the noise I made,
full suddenly he fled.
